meta.title: Hoi An Lantern Boat Ride at Night 🏮 | Vietnam
meta.description:
Hoi An Lantern Boat Ride at Night 🏮 | Vietnam

Experience the magic of Hoi An at night as we take a peaceful lantern boat ride along the Hoai River. 🏮✨

Surrounded by colorful lanterns, glowing reflections, and the beautiful atmosphere of Hoi An Ancient Town, this was one of the memorable moments of our family trip to Vietnam.

📍 Hoi An Ancient Town, Vietnam 🇻🇳
